prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web homepage direction comp, landscape 16:10
Primary request: Design the complete first viewport of the Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar website for Lucena City in a “Dieline Vanity Counter” visual world. This is a real salon booking product, not a poster or photograph.
Scene/backdrop: a structured salon vanity counter translated into a responsive web interface
Subject: service discovery leading directly into online appointment booking
Style/medium: award-winning editorial web UI mockup, production-realistic
Composition/framing: 1536-by-960-like landscape viewport; thin navigation with Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar at left and Services, Reviews, About, Login, Book at right; asymmetrical first viewport with one decisive unbranded salon-treatment photograph occupying about 42 percent; large headline “Your visit, precisely arranged.”; die-cut service panels overlap a mirrored tray; a persistent ticket tab contains the primary action “Choose a treatment”; show real service facts: “Gel Polish — ₱1,500 · 60 min”, “Spa Treatment — ₱1,200 · 60 min”, “Lash Extension — ₱1,800 · 60 min”; include a small “Open times” strip without invented availability values
Color palette: warm bone #f6f0e7, near-black aubergine #261d2a, lacquer plum #6d245b, blush lacquer #d87482, brushed chrome #b7b5b6
Materials/textures: mirrored acrylic, foil-stamped card, translucent glass, die-cut paper; physical material should be obvious but controls remain crisp
Text (verbatim): “Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar”; “Your visit, precisely arranged.”; “Choose a treatment”; “Gel Polish”; “₱1,500 · 60 min”; “Spa Treatment”; “₱1,200 · 60 min”; “Lash Extension”; “₱1,800 · 60 min”; “Open times”
Constraints: one bold negative-space cut creates a memorable silhouette; booking unfolds panel by panel; exact prices and durations stay legible; salon identity must dominate; no third-party logos; no false ratings, customer counts, awards, years, staff counts, certifications, hygiene claims, or exact address; this must read as a functional website
Avoid: generic rounded-card grid, ambient purple gradients, glassmorphism blur, cosmetic e-commerce packaging catalog, poster layout, illegible decorative text, watermark
